greeting: BEHOLD! EL SCORCHO! Champion of the Cinder Arena!
You stand before THE MASKED INFERNO! Tremble! Or... just say hi. Either works.
Another challenger? Or a FAN? I accept both!
The champion never rests! Except Tuesdays. Tuesdays are for laundry.
Hear that crowd? They're chanting MY NAME! ...Well, they're chanting 'LUCHA!' Close enough!
Welcome to MY arena! Where the ring is hot and the action is HOTTER!
You look strong! Ever thought about wrestling? We have a beginner's class!
EL! SCOR! CHO! The rhythm of CHAMPIONS!
dialog.championship_status: Undefeated in 47 matches! Well, 46. There was that tie with the barrel. Long story.
dialog.training_regimen: Five hundred pushups! In magma! Okay, NEAR magma. I'm tough, not crazy.
dialog.frost_challenge: I hear Frost has a wrestler called 'The Blizzard Bruiser.' I WILL FIGHT HIM! Cold vs Hot! The ULTIMATE MATCH!
dialog.mask_significance: This mask was forged in sacred fire! Passed down through three champions! ...Okay, I bought it at a gift shop. But it's LUCKY!
rumor: The barrelgobs keep trying to steal my championship belt. They're... very short. It's weird.
Some say there's a sumo in Prism who could beat me. LIES!
The Ironchef challenged me to a cook-off once. I won by default. He made lava soup.
dialog.championship_belt_quest: You want to help the green challenger? HA! Adorable! But I like your spirit. Tell you what - help him train, and I'll give him a REAL fight. Not that I'd lose! EL SCORCHO NEVER LOSES! ...Much.
dialog.post_championship_belt: So the green one actually put up a fight! Impressive! You've got an eye for talent, friend!
farewell: Stay strong! Stay fiery! Stay CHAMPION-MATERIAL!
EL SCORCHO... AWAAAAAY! ...To the locker room. Close enough!
Keep your elbows up and your head down! Wrestling wisdom!
Come watch my next match! Front row seats! For a small donation!
ambient_barks: I AM THE CHAMPION! ...Of my own heart!
Flexing is an art form! Watch and learn!
The crowd loves me! Can you hear them? CAN YOU?!
Next match: ME vs DESTINY! Spoiler: I WIN!
Is my mask straight? Check my mask!
dialog.time_dawn: Early training! Before the magma gets too melty!
dialog.time_noon: Peak performance time! The heat fuels me!
dialog.time_dusk: Evening match time! The arena awaits!
dialog.time_night: Post-match cool down! Ice baths! So cold! So necessary!

party_reactions.kade: Okay, I HAVE to see this guy wrestle.
party_reactions.nix7: Athletic performance within normal parameters. Showmanship: excessive.
party_reactions.twist: OH MAN OH MAN OH MAN! Can I wrestle too?! PLEASE?!
party_reactions.korr: The confidence is... impressive. The technique, less so.
party_reactions.renna: Does the mask have magical properties? Or just psychological?
party_reactions.suresh: Pride cometh before a fall. But he IS entertaining.
party_reactions.sova: I could take him. Probably. He's... very enthusiastic.
party_reactions.grit: Showboat. But good heart. Seen worse soldiers.
party_reactions.ashka: Fire in the spirit! I approve!
party_reactions.senna: Loud. But at least he's honest about it.
party_reactions.callum: Is... is he going to be okay? Wrestling in this heat?

relationship_dialog.acquaintance: I recognize you! You're becoming a regular!
relationship_dialog.friend: My friend! Come to watch me WIN again?
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You! My lucky charm! Every match you watch, I win! Coincidence? I THINK NOT!
